scope: Summaries of internal AI review messages, not external peer review or full reviewer transcripts

reviewers.verdict: go for bounded experiment, no enterprise claim
findings: Author episodes receive policies and catalogs, not measurements or labels.
Both runtime arms receive the same plan, evidence and code-computed checks.
Plan syntax is not semantic approval; plan failures must be separated from model failures.
Broad and narrow questions share one request; their latency cannot be compared independently.
Cobalt omits the quiet ignore branch and misroutes some unresolved comparability states.
Maple needs careful distinction between absent exceptions and uncertain exception evidence; combined exception/missing-data precedence is not fully specified.
Quartz incorrectly combines some missing-data conditions, omits a signed-reconciliation ignore branch and has an unsafe notify default.

repair_history: A policy-only reviewer proposed a repair without viewing the new transfer cases.
The main reviewer rejected its blanket unknown-to-investigate guard: explicit missing-data branches were preempted. The rejected plan is retained in rejected-review-plan.json.
A second static revision moved policy-specific data-gap handling before unrelated unknown guards and removed duplicate Quartz high/routine checks.
Nineteen abstract truth-vector checks passed against both a reference matcher and the actual experimental composer before live transfer testing. These are not live model cases.

primary_result.claims: No correctness or end-to-end resource advantage. No production runtime change.
